statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. dagger-engine links only github.com/docker/docker/pkg/idtools, libnetwork/resolvconf, libnetwork/internal/resolvconf and profiles/seccomp from the module; the dagger CLI and dagger-init link only pkg/idtools. Checked with `go list -deps -tags dfexcludepatterns,dfparents ./cmd/engine ./cmd/dagger ./cmd/init` at v0.21.11 with docker v28.5.2: no daemon, plugin or API server package is in the build. The build fails if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
